prompts.name: Folded N
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original professional logo symbol for Natha Labs, a Dubai AI consultancy building custom AI software and business workflow automation. This is a serious corporate identity exploration, not a poster or illustration. Flat vector-like geometry, crisp silhouettes, deliberate optical balance, extremely simple and memorable, suitable for a favicon and a premium software studio. Single solid deep forest green #1d5146. Genuine transparent background. Square canvas. Center the symbol and let it occupy about 65% of the canvas width and height. No lettering, no company name, no labels, no tagline, no border around the image, no shadows, gradients, 3D, texture, mockups, circuits, brains, robots, sparkles, infinity signs or generic hexagons. Do not copy an existing brand. Direction: a bold uppercase N constructed as one continuous folded ribbon, with two sturdy vertical strokes and a strong diagonal bridge. Use negative space and exactly one small crisp notch at a fold to suggest transformation from input into output. The mark must read clearly as N. All green regions are exactly one flat color, the fold is expressed only by the silhouette and transparent negative space. Broad confident strokes, restrained softened outer corners, no decorative elements. Aim for the clarity of a beautifully designed industrial monogram.

Do not copy an existing brand. Direction: a compact N monogram formed from three or four rounded geometric modules that meet to create a connected path. Flat vector-like geometry, crisp silhouettes, deliberate optical balance, extremely simple and memorable, suitable for a favicon and a premium software studio. Single solid deep forest green #1d5146. Do not copy an existing brand. Direction: an elegant custom geometric monogram combining capital N and capital L into a single unmistakable compact symbol.
